releases.author: illuwa
releases.description:
Initial public release.

- Two-way vault sync over WebDAV (self-hosted NAS)
- Desktop + mobile (iOS/Android)
- NFC/NFD-safe filename handling
- Per-device shard indexes with causal conflict resolution
- Tombstone deletions, mass-delete guard, conflict copies
- Retry with backoff + checkpoint every 200 files
